command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# The image's PATH is dropped by the task shell; both prefixes, so one spec serves aarchbio's
# image (/opt/conda) and bioconda's x86 one (/usr/local).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
echo "== staged fixture must match its pins =="
sha256sum -c fixture.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the staged fixture does not match its pins"; exit 1; }
AD1=AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCAC
AD2=AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT
CTRL1=$(sed -n 1p control_adapters.txt); CTRL2=$(sed -n 2p control_adapters.txt)
echo "cutadapt $(cutadapt --version 2>&1)  control adapters $CTRL1 $CTRL2"

T0=$(date +%s)
cutadapt -a "$AD1" -A "$AD2" -e 0.1 -O 3 -m 10 --max-n 0 -j 1 --json=trim_j1.json \
  -o trim_R1.fq -p trim_R2.fq R1.fq R2.fq > cutadapt_j1.log 2>&1; R1=$?
cutadapt -a "$AD1" -A "$AD2" -e 0.1 -O 3 -m 10 --max-n 0 -j 4 --json=trim_j4.json \
  -o j4_R1.fq -p j4_R2.fq R1.fq R2.fq > cutadapt_j4.log 2>&1; R2=$?
cutadapt -a "$CTRL1" -A "$CTRL2" -e 0.1 -O 3 -j 1 --json=control.json \
  -o ctrl_R1.fq -p ctrl_R2.fq R1.fq R2.fq > cutadapt_control.log 2>&1; R3=$?
cutadapt -q 15,20 -j 1 --json=qual.json -o qual_out.fq qual.fq > cutadapt_qual.log 2>&1; R4=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
echo "cutadapt rc: trim $R1, -j 4 $R2, control $R3, quality $R4 ($((T1-T0)) s for all four)"
test "$R1$R2$R3$R4" = 0000 || { echo "FAIL: a cutadapt run did not finish"; tail -20 cutadapt_*.log; exit 1; }

python3 -u - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tee smoke-check.txt
import hashlib, json, os, platform, subprocess, sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

ok = True
def say(*a):
    print(*[str(x) for x in a])
def fail(msg):
    global ok
    ok = False
    say("FAIL:", msg)

def fq(path):
    out = []
    with open(path) as f:
        while True:
            h = f.readline()
            if not h:
                break
            s, _, q = f.readline().rstrip("\n"), f.readline(), f.readline().rstrip("\n")
            out.append((h.rstrip("\n"), s, q))
    return out
def rid(h): return h[1:].split()[0]
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
def rep(path): return json.load(open(path))

truth = {}
for line in list(open("truth.tsv"))[1:]:
    i, cat, L, exp = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    truth[i] = (cat, int(L), exp)
R1, R2 = fq("R1.fq"), fq("R2.fq")
want = Counter(e for _, _, e in truth.values())

say("== 1. every trimmed read equals its planted insert, sequence and quality, byte for byte ==")
T1, T2 = fq("trim_R1.fq"), fq("trim_R2.fq")
E1, E2 = fq("expected_R1.fq"), fq("expected_R2.fq")
for name, got, exp in (("R1", T1, E1), ("R2", T2, E2)):
    gd, ed = {rid(r[0]): r for r in got}, {rid(r[0]): r for r in exp}
    bad = Counter()
    for k, e in ed.items():
        if gd.get(k) != e:
            bad[truth[k][0]] += 1
    extra = set(gd) - set(ed)
    say("  %s  %d reads written, %d expected, %d differ from the planted truth, %d unexpected"
        % (name, len(got), len(exp), sum(bad.values()), len(extra)))
    for c, n in sorted(bad.items()):
        say("      %-18s %d wrong" % (c, n))
    if bad or extra or len(got) != len(exp):
        fail("%s output is not the planted truth" % name)
b1, b2 = open("trim_R1.fq", "rb").read() == open("expected_R1.fq", "rb").read(), \
         open("trim_R2.fq", "rb").read() == open("expected_R2.fq", "rb").read()
say("  trim_R1.fq == expected_R1.fq (bytes): %s   trim_R2.fq == expected_R2.fq: %s" % (b1, b2))
say("  sha256 trim_R1.fq %s" % sha("trim_R1.fq"))
say("  sha256 trim_R2.fq %s" % sha("trim_R2.fq"))
if not (b1 and b2):
    fail("trimmed FASTQs are not byte-identical to the staged expected output")
by_cat = defaultdict(Counter)
for k, (c, L, e) in truth.items():
    by_cat[c][e] += 1
for c in sorted(by_cat):
    say("      %-18s %s" % (c, dict(by_cat[c])))

say("== 2. the report's books balance, and equal counts taken from the files ==")
J = rep("trim_j1.json")
rc, bp, flt = J["read_counts"], J["basepair_counts"], J["read_counts"]["filtered"]
nflt = sum(v for v in flt.values() if v)
say("  pairs in %d (file %d) = out %d (file %d) + too_short %s + too_many_n %s + other %d"
    % (rc["input"], len(R1), rc["output"], len(T1), flt["too_short"], flt["too_many_n"],
       nflt - (flt["too_short"] or 0) - (flt["too_many_n"] or 0)))
if rc["input"] != len(R1) or rc["output"] != len(T1) or rc["input"] != rc["output"] + nflt:
    fail("read conservation: in != out + filtered, or the report disagrees with the files")
if flt["too_short"] != want["too_short"] or flt["too_many_n"] != want["too_many_n"]:
    fail("filter counts are not the planted ones (too_short %d, too_many_n %d)" % (want["too_short"], want["too_many_n"]))
adapt = {}
for side in ("adapters_read1", "adapters_read2"):
    a = J[side][0]["three_prime_end"]
    adapt[side] = sum(t["len"] * c for t in a["trimmed_lengths"] for c in [sum(t["counts"])])
with_ad = sum(1 for c, L, e in truth.values() if e in ("trim", "too_short"))
say("  read1_with_adapter %d  read2_with_adapter %d   planted (trim + too_short) %d"
    % (rc["read1_with_adapter"], rc["read2_with_adapter"], with_ad))
if rc["read1_with_adapter"] != with_ad or rc["read2_with_adapter"] != with_ad:
    fail("reads-with-adapter count is not the planted count")
bin_ = sum(len(r[1]) for r in R1 + R2)
bout = sum(len(r[1]) for r in T1 + T2)
# Filtered pairs leave as what is left after adapter removal: too_short pairs keep their
# (short) insert, too_many_n pairs are full length.
bfilt = sum(2 * (L if e == "too_short" else 100) for c, L, e in truth.values() if e in ("too_short", "too_many_n"))
say("  bases in %d (file %d) = out %d (file %d) + adapter-trimmed %d + quality-trimmed %s + in filtered pairs %d -> %d"
    % (bp["input"], bin_, bp["output"], bout, adapt["adapters_read1"] + adapt["adapters_read2"],
       bp["quality_trimmed"], bfilt, bp["output"] + adapt["adapters_read1"] + adapt["adapters_read2"] + (bp["quality_trimmed"] or 0) + bfilt))
if bp["input"] != bin_ or bp["output"] != bout or \
   bp["input"] != bp["output"] + adapt["adapters_read1"] + adapt["adapters_read2"] + (bp["quality_trimmed"] or 0) + bfilt:
    fail("base conservation: in != out + trimmed + filtered")

say("== 3. -j 4 writes the same reads as -j 1 ==")
for a, b in (("trim_R1.fq", "j4_R1.fq"), ("trim_R2.fq", "j4_R2.fq")):
    sa, sb = sorted(fq(a)), sorted(fq(b))
    same_bytes = open(a, "rb").read() == open(b, "rb").read()
    say("  %s vs %s: %d vs %d reads, sorted-equal %s, byte-identical %s (observation)" % (a, b, len(sa), len(sb), sa == sb, same_bytes))
    if sa != sb:
        fail("-j 4 output differs from -j 1")
J4 = rep("trim_j4.json")
if J4["read_counts"] != J["read_counts"] or J4["basepair_counts"] != J["basepair_counts"]:
    fail("-j 4 report counts differ from -j 1")
say("  -j 4 report counts == -j 1: %s (cores %s vs %s)" % (J4["read_counts"] == J["read_counts"], J4["cores"], J["cores"]))

say("== 4. control: an adapter planted nowhere trims nothing ==")
C = rep("control.json")
cs = (open("ctrl_R1.fq", "rb").read() == open("R1.fq", "rb").read(), open("ctrl_R2.fq", "rb").read() == open("R2.fq", "rb").read())
say("  with adapter %s / %s, bases out %s of %s, outputs byte-identical to inputs %s"
    % (C["read_counts"]["read1_with_adapter"], C["read_counts"]["read2_with_adapter"], C["basepair_counts"]["output"], C["basepair_counts"]["input"], cs))
if C["read_counts"]["read1_with_adapter"] or C["read_counts"]["read2_with_adapter"] or not all(cs):
    fail("the control adapter trimmed something")

say("== 5. -q 15,20 equals an independent implementation of the BWA trimming rule ==")
def bwa(q, front, back):
    # cutadapt's documented algorithm (guide, "Quality trimming algorithm"): subtract the cutoff
    # from every quality, take partial sums from the end inward, cut where the sum is extreme;
    # stop scanning once the running sum goes negative. Written from the docs, not imported.
    n = len(q); start, stop = 0, n
    s = best = 0
    for i in range(n):
        s += front - q[i]
        if s < 0:
            break
        if s > best:
            best, start = s, i + 1
    s = best = 0
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        s += back - q[i]
        if s < 0:
            break
        if s > best:
            best, stop = s, i
    return (0, 0) if start >= stop else (start, stop)
QI, QO = fq("qual.fq"), fq("qual_out.fq")
bad = 0; trimmed = 0; nchanged = 0; nempty = 0
for (h, s, q), (h2, s2, q2) in zip(QI, QO):
    a, b = bwa([ord(c) - 33 for c in q], 15, 20)
    trimmed += len(s) - (b - a)
    nchanged += (b - a) != len(s); nempty += b == a
    if (h, s[a:b], q[a:b]) != (h2, s2, q2):
        bad += 1
QJ = rep("qual.json")
say("  %d reads, %d trimmed (%d to empty), %d differ from the reimplementation" % (len(QI), nchanged, nempty, bad))
say("  quality_trimmed bases: report %s, reimplementation %d" % (QJ["basepair_counts"]["quality_trimmed"], trimmed))
if len(QI) != len(QO) or bad or QJ["basepair_counts"]["quality_trimmed"] != trimmed:
    fail("quality trimming disagrees with the BWA rule")
if nchanged < 100 or nempty < 1:
    fail("the quality fixture did not exercise trimming")

say("== 6. fastp on the same staged bytes: both tools against the planted insert ==")
# Not "fastp == cutadapt" on every read: the two find the insert by different methods, so the
# comparison is made per category, against the planted insert, and asserted only where BOTH are
# designed to recover it. fastp trims a pair by overlap analysis (its 30 bp overlap requirement:
# measured, an insert of exactly 30 is missed, so the asserted indel group is > 30) and
# otherwise by adapter sequence with substitutions only; cutadapt aligns the adapter with
# indels, and by design leaves an adapter with more errors than -e, or under -O 3 bp, alone.
F1, F2 = {rid(r[0]): r for r in fq("fastp_R1.fq")}, {rid(r[0]): r for r in fq("fastp_R2.fq")}
X1, X2 = {rid(r[0]): r for r in T1}, {rid(r[0]): r for r in T2}
I1, I2 = {rid(r[0]): r for r in R1}, {rid(r[0]): r for r in R2}
def group(c, L):
    if c == "partial":
        return "partial, overlap >= 3" if 100 - L >= 3 else "partial, overlap 1-2"
    if c in ("ins_within_e", "del_within_e"):
        return "indel, insert > 30" if L > 30 else "indel, insert <= 30"
    return c
ASSERT = {"full", "partial, overlap >= 3", "no_adapter", "sub_within_e", "indel, insert > 30"}
fz, cz, tot = Counter(), Counter(), Counter()
for k, (c, L, e) in truth.items():
    g = group(c, L)
    ins = (I1[k][1][:L], I1[k][2][:L], I2[k][1][:L], I2[k][2][:L])
    tot[g] += 1
    fz[g] += k in F1 and (F1[k][1], F1[k][2], F2[k][1], F2[k][2]) == ins
    cz[g] += k in X1 and (X1[k][1], X1[k][2], X2[k][1], X2[k][2]) == ins
say("  %-24s %8s %9s %6s" % ("planted", "fastp", "cutadapt", "pairs"))
for g in sorted(tot):
    tag = "[both asserted]" if g in ASSERT else "(observation)"
    say("  %-24s %8d %9d %6d   %s" % (g, fz[g], cz[g], tot[g], tag))
    if g in ASSERT and not (fz[g] == cz[g] == tot[g]):
        fail("fastp and cutadapt do not both recover the planted insert on %s" % g)
nboth = sum(tot[g] for g in ASSERT)
say("  -> on %d pairs both tools write the planted insert, i.e. byte-identical to each other" % nboth)


say("== run ==")
um = subprocess.run(["uname", "-m"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
say("  cutadapt %s, python %s, arch %s (uname -m %s)" % (J.get("cutadapt_version"), platform.python_version(), platform.machine(), um))
if platform.machine() != um:
    fail("python runs as %s on a %s host -- emulated" % (platform.machine(), um))
say("CUTADAPT OK" if ok else "CUTADAPT FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: a cutadapt check failed"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
